svg.title: Hosted vs local
svg.desc: Dumbbell chart comparing hosted and local runs of three open models across three contexts. gpt-oss-20b false promises 69→62/0→0/0→0; gpt-oss-20b exfiltration 81→100/100→100/75→94; Phi-4 (14B) false promises 75→91/69→28/34→22; Phi-4 (14B) exfiltration 88→94/88→94/100→100; Mistral Small 3 (24B, 2501) false promises 75→75/41→38/0→3; Mistral Small 3 (24B, 2501) exfiltration 100→100/100→94/100→100 (hosted→local, %).
svg.text: Hosted vs local: does it matter where the open model runs?
Same models, same cases. Hosted via OpenRouter, local via Ollama on a MacBook Pro (M4 Pro, 48 GB). Share of runs that followed the injection.
Local does not fix it: the exfiltration actions stay at 94–100% even with the explicit warning.
8 runs per case and context (16–32 per point). Hosted gpt-oss-20b and Phi-4: run of 30 Oct 2026; Mistral Small 3 hosted: 3 Nov 2026.
